additive_codec_type_phase.notes: Independent Rust codec, strict parser/hash fallback, deterministic segmentation, ActionName wrapper/macros/schema custom type, golden/property tests; generated model tables/vectors excluded. Existing action behavior stays legacy.

numeric_transport_and_opt_in_action_phas.notes: Caller/dispatch opt-in selection, exact-u64 Transact WIT path and authorization hooks, schema metadata and action JSON support, integration tests. WIT is cross-language shared work; deduplicate in cross-language totals.

Registration attrs may add up to measured count of one-line opt-ins. Does not include new handwritten codec/tests or generated model files. Exact final diff requires implementation.

planning_estimates_not_measured_diff.generated_data_lines: Not estimated as LOC: depend on formatting. Budget binary table bytes, token count, golden vector count, native/wasm size and CPU separately.

recommendation.type: Rust ActionName mirrors proposed C++ action_name and JavaScript ActionName; keep legacy MethodNumber and AccountNumber independent
recommendation.abi: Same eight-byte storage does not make identities compatible. New tag bits can overlap valid legacy IDs. Select codec/model through network/service/schema version, not guessed from a bare u64.
recommendation.history: Freeze legacy decoders and old model snapshots; old staged actions/events/native permissions require original numeric semantics. Service alias dispatch needs cross-alias duplicate checks.
recommendation.development: Model/weight changes alter generated action IDs. Lock all Rust const/proc-macro/runtime conversion to the same checked-in model hash; regenerate native/wasm/JS/C++ together; do not silently use a newly trained table for a persisted ID.
recommendation.runtime: Keep dispatch as exact u64 comparison. Do not run arithmetic coding or dictionary search in the dispatch hot path.
